battle.name: 托勒密·拉齊羅斯內戰
battle.theater: 亞歷山卓與地中海東岸
battle.brief: 公元前107年秋，托勒密九世被亞歷山卓民眾逐出，母子反目引發內戰；他退據塞浦路斯，前103年渡海解阿科之圍並在約旦河畔擊敗雅那烏斯，前88年軍民倒戈逐走托勒密十世，他重返孟斐斯加冕。卡面的埃及月牙劍是前1500年定型的青銅短劍，到本役已退為象徵，實戰近身武器改由科普斯與希臘短劍擔任。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場衝突是托勒密王朝晚期在埃及本土爆發的一場王室內戰，交戰雙方都不是外來軍隊，而是同一王朝的母子與兄弟。托勒密九世·索特二世一方，核心是亞歷山卓的城民兵（各健身房少年兵組成的民兵）與王宮直屬的禁衛埃及步兵；逃出埃及後，他以塞浦路斯為基地，得到塞浦路斯與黎巴嫩沿岸的艦隊與僱傭兵支持，並在猶太戰線上吸收當地雇兵。克麗奧佩特拉三世與托勒密十世一方，則掌握亞歷山卓朝廷、尼羅河三角洲東端的佩魯西姆行省軍隊，以及王室的埃及本地兵，包括弓手、投石手與尼比亞輕步兵；他們在敘利亞方向得到塞琉古王國安條克九世的外交支持，在黎巴嫩與猶太戰線上調動腓尼基海軍、哈斯蒙王朝的猶太王亞歷山大·雅那烏斯，以及納巴泰的阿雷塔斯三世。第三方並非交戰方，卻決定戰局：羅馬共和國在公元前112年派元老路基奧·梅米烏斯出使，前86年盧庫盧的艦隊駛入亞歷山卓；托勒密十世更以對羅馬的大筆貸款換得一份把王國遺給羅馬的遺囑，等於把繼承權交到羅馬手上。這場戰爭的指揮系統因此極其特殊：雙方都沒有遠征軍，勝負取決於亞歷山卓城民兵的效忠宣誓、駐軍的倒戈，以及佩魯西姆與塞浦路斯兩個咽喉點的掌握。
countriesEn: This conflict was a civil war that broke out inside Egypt itself in the late Ptolemaic period, and neither side was a foreign army: the opposing parties were a mother and son, and two brothers, of the same dynasty. The side of Ptolemy IX Soter II rested on the civic soldiers of Alexandria, the militia drawn from the young men of the city's gymnasia, together with the palace guard and the native Egyptian infantry of the crown; after being expelled from Egypt he used Cyprus as his base, drawing on the Cypriot and Levantine fleets and on mercenaries, and he took in local auxiliaries on the Judaean front. The side of Cleopatra III and Ptolemy X held the Alexandrian court, the provincial garrison of Pelusium at the eastern tip of the Nile delta, and the Egyptian native troops of the crown, archers, slingers and light Nubian infantry; it enjoyed diplomatic support from the Seleucid king Antiochus IX in Syria, and on the Levantine and Judaean fronts it brought to bear Phoenician sea power, the forces of the Hasmonean king of Judaea Alexander Jannaeus, and the Nabataeans under Aretas III. A third party was not a belligerent at all, yet it shaped the outcome: the Roman Republic sent the senator Lucius Memmius as envoy in 112 BC, and Lucullus's fleet entered Alexandria in 86 BC; Ptolemy X even took a large loan from Rome in return for a will that bequeathed his kingdom to Rome, effectively handing the succession to the Romans. The command structure of the war was therefore quite peculiar: neither side fought a distant campaign, and the result turned on the oath of allegiance given by the Alexandrian civic soldiers, on the defection of the garrison, and on control of two chokepoints, Pelusium and Cyprus.
people: 托勒密九世·索特二世（約前143/2年或前140/39年生，前116至前107年及前88至前81年在位）是這場內戰的起點。他出自托勒密八世與克麗奧佩特拉三世的婚姻，綽號『拉齊羅斯』，即鷹嘴豆，諷刺這位年輕國王醉心聲色。公元前116年父王遺囑把王位繼承權交給克麗奧佩特拉三世，亞歷山卓民眾騷動迫使她選了長子而非幼弟托勒密十世；前115年克麗奧佩特拉二世去世後，母親獨攬大權，逼他與克麗奧佩特拉四世離婚，他改娶幼妹克麗奧佩特拉·塞勒涅，生下貝勒尼基三世。前107年秋，他與母親決裂，亞歷山卓民眾暴動將他逐出城。克麗奧佩特拉三世隨即把從塞浦路斯趕回的幼子托勒密十世接入城，立為共同攝政。托勒密九世退據塞浦路斯，前106年再渡海奪島。記錄這段歷史的主要古代作者是保薩尼亞斯，他留下母子決裂與亞歷山卓暴動的記載；尤斯丁《龐培烏斯·特羅古斯》撮要保存了托勒密八世遺囑的說法；狄奧多羅斯記述前106年塞浦路斯的戰事；約瑟夫斯《猶太古史》則留下前103年托勒密九世與哈斯蒙王朝雅那烏斯交戰的經過。前88年率軍南下平定上埃及的將軍希拉克斯，前86年駛抵亞歷山卓的羅馬將軍盧庫盧，以及前112年出使並巡視法伊尤姆的元老梅米烏斯，都是這場內戰裡可以點名的人物。托勒密十世在位期間曾向安條克九世借兵對付猶大王約翰·海爾卡努斯，說明埃及的王位爭奪與敘利亞的兄弟爭位糾纏在一起。
peopleEn: Ptolemy IX Soter II, born about 143/2 BC or 140/39 BC and reigning in 116-107 BC and again in 88-81 BC, is the starting point of this civil war. He was born of the marriage of Ptolemy VIII and Cleopatra III, and his nickname Lathyros, the chickpea, mocked the young king's taste for pleasure. In 116 BC the will of his father left the succession in the hands of Cleopatra III, and the agitation of the Alexandrians forced her to choose the elder son rather than the younger, Ptolemy X; after the death of Cleopatra II before 115 BC his mother became the sole holder of power, forced him to divorce Cleopatra IV, and he married his younger sister Cleopatra Selene instead, by whom Berenice III was born. In the autumn of 107 BC he broke with his mother and the Alexandrian mob expelled him from the city. Cleopatra III then had the younger son Ptolemy X, who had come over from Cyprus, brought into the city and set on the throne as co-regent. Ptolemy IX withdrew to Cyprus and in 106 BC crossed the sea to take the island back. The principal ancient author of this stretch of history is Pausanias, who left an account of the breach between mother and son and of the riot in Alexandria; the Epitome of Pompeius Trogus by Justin preserves the story of Ptolemy VIII's will; Diodorus records the fighting over Cyprus in 106 BC; and Josephus's Antiquities of the Jews preserves the account of the clash between Ptolemy IX and the Hasmonean Jannaeus in 103 BC. General Hierax, who led the army south to pacify Upper Egypt in 88 BC, the Roman general Lucullus, whose fleet reached Alexandria in 86 BC, and the senator Memmius, who toured the Fayyum as envoy in 112 BC, are all figures who can be named in this war. During the reign of Ptolemy X he borrowed troops from Antiochus IX against the Judaean ruler John Hyrcanus, which shows the struggle over the Egyptian throne entangled with the fratricidal contest in Syria.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）：約前1500年定型、外彎單刃、砍下去不必拔刀的青銅短劍，源於埃及中王國至新王國的傳統，作為軍械是當時埃及人最典型的近戰武器。但到公元前107至前88年，月牙劍早已退居象徵位置——它仍在王室的禮器、祭司用品與軍械庫陳列中出現，實際執勤的則是功能相近的科普斯（kopis，單刃、刀背外彎、刀尖前傾）與希臘式短劍（xiphos）。卡牌要把月牙劍放回這個體系裏去看：它是埃及兵制的祖型，而托勒密王朝的步兵骨架已完全是馬其頓化。希臘化方陣步兵以五至六公尺長的方陣長矛（sarissa）為主武器，配阿爾戈斯式圓盾、亞麻布背帶甲（linothorax）與青銅頭盔，近身用短劍或科普斯；埃及本地兵與附庸軍以複合弓、投石索與標槍為主，兼有少量佩劍；重裝騎兵（clibanarii）與長槍騎兵負責追擊與掩護。托勒密王朝的海上力量最被低估：大型四十列槳船是主力，塞浦路斯與尼羅河三角洲的尼羅斯是基地，另有快速運輸用的無甲船（aphlaston）與偵察用小艇。攻城方面備有撞城錘、攻城塔、扭力弩與配重石弩（helepolis），狄奧多羅斯記載的巨型弩砲即是當時攻城戰的標誌。值得注意的是，雙方在這場內戰都沒有記錄使用戰象——塞琉古人在安條克三世時代已失去象群，此後希臘化諸王不再以象牙正面衝撞取勝。補給依靠尼羅河航運、佩特拉—加沙—佩魯西姆的商隊大道與沿海海運三條線，駱載由駱駝隊分擔。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh: a bronze short sword of about 1500 BC with a single outward-curving edge that did not need to be withdrawn after a cut, descending from the traditions of the Middle Kingdom and the New Kingdom, and as an arm it was the most characteristic close-combat weapon of the ancient Egyptians. But by 107-88 BC the khopesh had long since retired to a symbolic position: it still appeared in royal ceremonial objects, in the equipment of the priesthood and in the arsenal displays, while the weapon actually carried in the line of duty was the kopis, a single-edged blade with a curved back and a forward-raked point, or the Greek short sword, the xiphos. The card asks that the khopesh be set back into that system: it is the ancestor type of the Egyptian military order, while the infantry backbone of the Ptolemaic kingship had become entirely Macedonianised. The Hellenised phalanx soldier fought primarily with the sarissa, a pike of five to six metres, and carried the Argive round shield, a linen cuirass, the linothorax, and a bronze helmet, using a short sword or a kopis at close quarters; native Egyptian troops and auxiliaries fought with the composite bow, the sling and the javelin, with a few swords of their own; heavy cavalry, the clibanarii, and lancer horsemen provided pursuit and cover. The naval strength of the Ptolemies was the most underestimated element: large forty-rowed galleys formed the core, with bases on Cyprus and at Nilopolis in the Nile delta, alongside fast undecked transports, the aphlaston, and small scouting boats. For siege work they had battering rams, siege towers, torsion engines and counterweight stone-throwers, the helepolis, and the giant ballista described by Diodorus was the signature of sieges in this period. It is worth noting that neither side is recorded as using war elephants in this civil war: the Seleucids had already lost their herds in the age of Antiochus III, and from then on the Hellenistic kings no longer won by the frontal charge of elephants. Supply ran on three lines, the Nile, the caravan road from Petra through Gaza to Pelusium, and coastal shipping, with the baggage burden borne by camel trains.
tactics: 這場內戰可以分成兩個層次。首都層次是政治戰：亞歷山卓的健身房少年兵與駐軍對王室的效忠宣誓，往往比任何野戰更決定王位歸屬。前107年秋，母親一方以遇刺的假消息煽動民眾，暴動把托勒密九世逐出城；前88年春，軍民再聯合倒戈，把托勒密十世驅逐出埃及。這種不必經過戰鬥就能改換君主的機制，正是王朝晚期托勒密政權的特色。地理層次則是幾個咽喉點的爭奪。佩魯西姆在尼羅河三角洲東角，是從黎凡特進入埃及的唯一陸路門戶，托勒密十世正是從塞浦路斯航抵佩魯西姆，再被迎入亞歷山卓。托勒密九世在島上遭逐後退到敘利亞北部的塞琉基亞（皮里亞），前106年再渡海攻島，奪取薩拉米斯與帕福斯的港灣與島上艦隊，切斷腓尼基航運，這是以海權換陸權的典型打法。前103年他先解托勒美斯（阿科）之圍，再入加利利，於約旦河附近的阿索豐擊敗雅那烏斯，掠奪猶太；對手隨即以兩路反制：托勒密十世由海入腓尼基再陸路直取大馬士革，克麗奧佩特拉三世親率大軍圍困阿科，切斷他回埃及的陸路。托勒密九世冬天退守加沙，前102年初再海路返島——冬季陸路被封、海路又掌握在對方手中，正是他無法回國的技術原因。前88年11月，他同時辦兩件事：在孟斐斯舉行全國性加冕以爭取正統，並派將軍希拉克斯沿尼羅河南下，連下底比斯、收復至菲利亞，一舉恢復王令到達上埃及。
tacticsEn: This civil war can be read on two levels. At the level of the capital it was a political war: the oath of allegiance given by the young men of the Alexandrian gymnasia and by the garrison decided the succession more often than any pitched battle did. In the autumn of 107 BC the motherly party stirred the mob with a false report of an attempted assassination, and the riot expelled Ptolemy IX from the city; in the spring of 88 BC soldiers and citizens combined once more to drive Ptolemy X out of Egypt. A mechanism able to change the ruler without a battle was the hallmark of the late Ptolemaic state. At the geographical level the contest was over chokepoints. Pelusium stands at the eastern point of the Nile delta and is the only land gate into Egypt from the Levant, and it was to Pelusium that Ptolemy X sailed from Cyprus before being escorted into Alexandria. After being rebuffed on the island, Ptolemy IX withdrew to Seleucia in Pieria in northern Syria and in 106 BC crossed the sea again to attack the island, taking the harbours of Salamis and Paphos and the Cypriot fleet, which cut Phoenician shipping; this was a classic exchange of sea power for land power. In 103 BC he first relieved Ptolemais Akko from the siege, then entered Galilee, defeated Jannaeus at Asophon near the River Jordan and despoiled Judaea; the opponents replied with a two-pronged counter-offensive: Ptolemy X entered Phoenicia by sea and then marched by land on Damascus, while Cleopatra III led the army in person to besiege Akko, cutting off his land route back to Egypt. Ptolemy IX wintered at Gaza and in the early part of 102 BC returned to the island by sea. With the land route closed in winter and the sea route in his opponent's hands, this was the technical reason he could not get home. In November 88 BC he did two things at once: he held a coronation at Memphis, the nationwide enthronement that gave him legitimacy, and he sent the general Hierax south along the Nile, which carried Thebes quickly and restored the royal orders as far as Philae in a single stroke.
data: 這場內戰留下的是一份以年份為主幹的編年，而不是一份戰果表。可以確定並排出先後的節點有：前107年秋托勒密九世被逐出亞歷山卓；前106年他自敘利亞渡海奪回塞浦路斯；前105年後昔蘭尼落入同父異母弟托勒密·阿庇翁手中；前103年雅那烏斯圍困托勒美斯，托勒密九世渡海解圍，再於阿索豐擊敗之；前102年初他退回塞浦路斯，此後十八年事蹟幾近空白，只知前96年阿庇翁死而無嗣、把昔蘭尼遺給羅馬；前91年上埃及出現反叛政權；前88年春亞歷山卓軍民驅逐托勒密十世，同年11月托勒密九世在孟斐斯加冕，11月又派大軍南征，年底恢復控制至菲利亞，下努比亞仍由麥羅埃統治；前86年盧庫盧的羅馬艦隊抵達亞歷山卓；前81年8月5日托勒密九世立女兒貝勒尼基三世為共同攝政，同年12月左右去世。地理尺度上，亞歷山卓至佩魯西姆陸路約兩百公里，加沙至佩魯西姆沿海約三百公里，底比斯至菲利亞沿河約兩百公里，尼羅河自亞歷山卓至孟斐斯約八百公里航程。兵力方面必須說明：保薩尼亞斯、尤斯丁、狄奧多羅斯與約瑟夫斯都沒有留下這幾次行動的確切人數，只能說晚期的托勒密野戰軍通常在數萬人量級，遠低於前三世紀動輒十萬以上的動員，而前88年南征被記作大軍。真正決定王位的是亞歷山卓城民兵的人數與態度。武器年表上，月牙劍定型於約前1500年，到本役已歷約一千四百年，作為象徵性兵器留存，作為實戰兵器早已被科普斯取代。
dataEn: What this civil war leaves behind is a chronology built on years rather than a table of results. The points that can be established and put in order are these: in the autumn of 107 BC Ptolemy IX was expelled from Alexandria; in 106 BC he crossed the sea from Syria and retook Cyprus; after 105 BC Cyrene passed into the hands of his half-brother Ptolemy Apion; in 103 BC Jannaeus besieged Ptolemais, Ptolemy IX sailed over and relieved it, and then defeated him at Asophon; in the early part of 102 BC he withdrew to Cyprus, after which eighteen years pass in almost complete silence, the one thing known being that in 96 BC Apion died without heirs and bequeathed Cyrene to Rome; in 91 BC a rebel regime appeared in Upper Egypt; in the spring of 88 BC the soldiers and people of Alexandria drove out Ptolemy X, and in the same year, in November, Ptolemy IX was crowned at Memphis, and in November again a large army was sent south, control being restored to Philae by the end of the year while Lower Nubia remained under the kingdom of Meroë; in 86 BC Lucullus's Roman fleet reached Alexandria; on 5 August 81 BC Ptolemy IX raised his daughter Berenice III to the status of co-regent, and he himself died around December of that year. As for scale of distance, the land road from Alexandria to Pelusium is about two hundred kilometres, the coastal route from Gaza to Pelusium about three hundred, the river reach from Thebes to Philae about two hundred, and the Nile passage from Alexandria to Memphis about eight hundred. On numbers of men a caution is needed: Pausanias, Justin, Diodorus and Josephus all leave no exact headcounts for these operations, so the only statement that can be made is that a late Ptolemaic field army was on the order of tens of thousands, far below the mobilisations of a hundred thousand and more of the third century, and that the expedition of 88 BC is described as a large army. What really decided the throne was the size and mood of the Alexandrian civic soldiers. In the chronology of weapons, the khopesh was fixed in form about 1500 BC, so by this war it was some fourteen centuries old: surviving as a symbolic arm, already replaced in actual service by the kopis.
cause: 這場內戰的根子在托勒密王朝的繼承制度。托勒密家的做法是共治加分封：國王在世時把土地與王位分給兄弟，兄弟再各自成軍，形成永不停歇的兄弟爭位。托勒密八世在公元前116年6月28日去世，遺囑把埃及交給克麗奧佩特拉三世並由她挑選托勒密九世或托勒密十世；亞歷山卓民眾的騷動迫使她選了長子。前116年10月的紙草文獻顯示，克麗奧佩特拉二世、克麗奧佩特拉三世與托勒密九世三人同時掛名共同攝政，權力實際握在克麗奧佩特拉二世手中。前115年克麗奧佩特拉二世死後，克麗奧佩特拉三世成為唯一的強勢者，逼長子與其妹夫克麗奧佩特拉四世離婚，把公主送去嫁給塞琉古的安條克九世——前114/113年，托勒密十世在塞浦路斯自稱塞浦路斯之王，兄弟對立公開化。托勒密九世本人不受歡迎，外號鷹嘴豆正反映亞歷山卓市民對這位國王的評價。前107年秋，母子正式決裂：克麗奧佩特拉三世自傷侍僕、當眾展示兒子謀殺我的傷口，亞歷山卓隨即暴動逐王。此前已有前130年托勒密·孟菲提斯被殺、前126年克麗奧佩特拉二世與托勒密八世內戰等先例，說明這場母子反目是王朝結構的必然產物，而不是偶發的人事糾紛。
causeEn: The root of this civil war lies in the succession system of the Ptolemaic dynasty. The Ptolemies governed by co-regency and partition: a king divided land and kingship among his brothers while still alive, and those brothers then raised their own armies, which produced an unending series of fratricidal struggles. Ptolemy VIII died on 28 June 116 BC, and his will left Egypt to Cleopatra III with the right to choose either Ptolemy IX or Ptolemy X; the agitation of the Alexandrians forced her to choose the elder son. A papyrus document of October 116 BC shows Cleopatra II, Cleopatra III and Ptolemy IX all named as co-regents at once, with real power in the hands of Cleopatra II. After the death of Cleopatra II before 115 BC, Cleopatra III became the only strong figure, forced her elder son to divorce his sister-wife Cleopatra IV and sent the princess to marry the Seleucid Antiochus IX; in 114/113 BC Ptolemy X proclaimed himself king of Cyprus on that island, and the rift between the brothers became public. Ptolemy IX himself was not popular, and the nickname of chickpea reflects exactly how the Alexandrian citizenry judged this king. In the autumn of 107 BC mother and son broke openly: Cleopatra III wounded her own eunuch servants and displayed before the people the wounds of an attempted murder by her son, and Alexandria at once revolted and expelled the king. Earlier precedents, such as the killing of Ptolemy Memphites in 130 BC and the civil war between Cleopatra II and Ptolemy VIII in 126 BC, show that this rupture between mother and son was the necessary product of the dynastic structure rather than an accidental personal quarrel.
impact: 這場內戰的第一個後果，是托勒密王朝式的分家共治被證明走不通。前107至前88年，埃及本土同時存在兩個自稱國王的托勒密，一個在亞歷山卓，一個在塞浦路斯加海外領地；塞浦路斯雖在島上擁有獨立的王國名義，卻成了流亡者的基地，島上的港口與艦隊被用來對付母邦，東地中海的航運秩序為此重排。哈斯蒙王朝的猶太捲入得更深：前103年雅那烏斯圍困托勒美斯，被托勒密九世解圍並在阿索豐擊敗，此舉令猶大向塞琉古求援，安條克三世南下黎巴嫩、終於引發第三次敘利亞戰爭，猶大自此在兩強之間取得更大的自主空間，也付出慘重代價。埃及的南方界線則在這場內戰的最後一章被永久改寫：前88年托勒密軍收復底比斯後僅推進到菲利亞，下努比亞落入麥羅埃，埃及對努比亞的直接統治就此中止。羅馬的作用更為長遠：托勒密十世以對羅馬的貸款換取遺囑，把王國繼承權交給羅馬，雖然前96年才真正接手的只是昔蘭尼，但此後每個亞歷山卓的國王都要在羅馬面前俯首，前86年盧庫盧的艦隊開進亞歷山卓索取軍資就是明證。最終，這一系王朝沒有一人善終，公元前30年埃及被羅馬吞併。
impactEn: The first consequence of this civil war was that the partition-and-co-rule system of the Ptolemies was shown not to work. Between 107 and 88 BC there were two Ptolemys in Egypt at the same time, each claiming to be king, one in Alexandria and the other in Cyprus with overseas lands; Cyprus, though it carried the title of a kingdom in its own right, became the base of an exile, its harbours and fleet turned against the mother country, and the shipping order of the eastern Mediterranean was rearranged in consequence. The Hasmonean kingdom of Judaea was drawn in more deeply: in 103 BC Jannaeus was besieging Ptolemais until Ptolemy IX relieved him and beat him at Asophon, an act that drove Judaea to seek help from the Seleucids and brought Antiochus III down into the Levant, ultimately setting off the Third Syrian War; Judaea gained a larger degree of freedom between the two powers, and paid dearly for it. The southern frontier of Egypt was permanently rewritten in the last chapter of this civil war: after the Ptolemaic army retook Thebes in 88 BC it advanced only as far as Philae, Lower Nubia passed to Meroë, and Egypt's direct rule over Nubia came to an end there. The role of Rome was longer-lived still: Ptolemy X exchanged a loan from Rome for a will handing the royal succession to Rome, and although what Rome actually received in 96 BC was only Cyrene, every king of Alexandria after that had to bow before the Romans, and Lucullus's fleet entering Alexandria in 86 BC to demand war funds is proof of it. In the end not one member of this line of kings died a natural death, and in 30 BC Egypt was swallowed by Rome.
result: 公元前88年春，亞歷山卓的軍隊與市民聯手把托勒密十世逐出埃及，召回了流亡塞浦路斯的前王。托勒密十世企圖奪回塞浦路斯，在進攻中身亡；他生前向羅馬舉下的巨額貸款與那份把王國遺給羅馬的遺囑，成為羅馬隨時可以索取的名分。托勒密九世於同年11月在孟斐斯正式加冕為法老，刻意廢去愛母尊號，並在官方祭祀與檔案中清除克麗奧佩特拉三世與托勒密十世的痕跡。國王歸位後做的第二件事是收復南方：11月即派大軍由將軍希拉克斯率領沿尼羅河南下，迅速奪回底比斯，王令恢復到菲利亞，下努比亞未予追討。塞浦路斯與希臘化埃及的航線重新統一，內戰於前88年結束。托勒密九世此後獨自統治至公元前81年12月左右，8月5日先立女兒貝勒尼基三世為共同攝政，隨即去世；貝勒尼基三世數月後被堂兄弟托勒密十一殺害，托勒密十一又被人殺死，托勒密十二登基，王朝由此走向最後二十年的崩解。前107至前88年的分裂至此收場：托勒密九世重掌埃及與塞浦路斯，卻也把王朝的存續押在亞歷山卓的民心與羅馬的善意之上。
resultEn: In the spring of 88 BC the soldiers and the citizens of Alexandria together drove Ptolemy X out of Egypt and recalled the former king who had been in exile on Cyprus. Ptolemy X attempted to retake Cyprus and was killed in the attempt; the enormous loan he had raised from Rome and the will that left his kingdom to Rome became a claim the Romans could press at any moment. In the same year, in November, Ptolemy IX was formally crowned as pharaoh at Memphis, deliberately dropping the epithet Philometor, and the traces of Cleopatra III and Ptolemy X were purged from the official cult and the archives. The second thing the restored king did was to recover the south: in November he sent a large army down the Nile under the general Hierax, which carried Thebes quickly, the royal orders reaching Philae again, and Lower Nubia was not pursued. The sea lanes of Cyprus and Hellenised Egypt were reunited, and the civil war ended in 88 BC. Ptolemy IX then ruled alone until about December 81 BC, raising his daughter Berenice III to the status of co-regent on 5 August shortly before his own death; a few months later Berenice III was murdered by her cousin Ptolemy XI, who was himself killed, and Ptolemy XII took the throne, and the dynasty thus entered the collapse of its last twenty years. The split of 107-88 BC came to its end in this way: Ptolemy IX recovered Egypt and Cyprus, and in so doing placed the survival of the dynasty in the hands of the Alexandrian populace and the goodwill of Rome.
